name: axtiva/flexible-graphql-bundle
purpose: Symfony bundle for schema-first GraphQL code generation in host Symfony applications.
primary_runtime: Host Symfony application consuming the bundle; this repository is not a standalone app.

repository_style.consumer_boundary: The host app supplies GraphQL SDL files, generated-code destination, bundle config, and any HTTP controller.

primary_workflows_summary.summary: Install the bundle and add flexible_graphql config in a consuming Symfony app.
Run cache:clear in the consuming app to regenerate GraphQL artifacts via the cache warmer.
Run the direct type-registry generator command when cache warm is not the preferred path.
Inspect the flexible_graphql command namespace exposed by the bundle.

core_behaviors: Processes flexible_graphql configuration and registers code-generator services, commands, and a cache warmer.
Generates all GraphQL types and a TypeRegistry class from SDL schema files.
Provides CLI scaffolding for directive, field, scalar, and type-registry generation.
Ships a default resolver backed by Symfony PropertyAccess for fallback field reads.
important_caveats: Config defaults are not fully synchronized across Configuration.php, bundled sample YAML, and docs examples.
Most executable workflows require a consuming Symfony app with bin/console, not this repository alone.
